ideas.pitch: An AI-powered IoT analytics platform that monitors power grid stability and water pump strain across the Galgotias University campus, predicting equipment failures before they happen using time-series forecasting models.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI: Predictive Maintenance for University Infrastructure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages genuine hard engineering in time-series forecasting, mirroring past winning projects like GeoNex-ATLAS, and directly solves a campus-specific problem that local judges will immediately recognize.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-localized nutrition tracking platform tailored to hostel mess menus, utilizing multimodal AI to analyze daily mess food photos and dynamically generate balanced meal adjustments for students.
ideas.title: NutriMess: Smart AI Mess Diet and Nutrition Planner for Hostels
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven concepts from recent nutrition hackathon winners into an ultra-relatable context for university students living in hostels.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent RAG system that aggregates student safety reports and campus security logs to forecast potential security hot spots around the Knowledge Centre and hostel blocks during late hours.
ideas.title: PeerGuard: Multi-Agent Campus Safety & Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent architectures and predictive modeling, echoing the winning strategy of greennovation-ai-platform and AI incident forecasting.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise-grade applicant tracking and risk mitigation platform built for university placement cells, utilizing graph intelligence to match student skill graphs with historical recruiter requirements.
ideas.title: PlacementIQ: AI-Powered Resume & Interview Risk Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the hard engineering approach of graph-based AML detection platforms, offering immediate utility to the organizing IEEE entrepreneurship group.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer micro-economy application for students to buy, sell, or trade academic project components, lab notes, and peer tutoring sessions with seamless simulated escrow.
ideas.title: StudyMesh: Decentralized Campus Resource & Skill Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements autonomous workflow patterns seen in winning agent marketplaces, scaled neatly into a tight 8-hour execution window.
